subject: Post-demo: Security documentation & incident/BCP timelines
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@pioneerlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Security documentation & incident/BCP timelines

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Jane — great conversation. Quick recap and outstanding asks so we can move the security review forward: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned an ongoing Type II audit with an expected report in Q1. Please confirm the anticipated completion month and whether any interim SOC-related artifacts (scope statement, SOC readiness letter) are available.

2) Regulatory applicability: you confirmed Pioneer handles patient-identifiable data for a subset of customers and expects HIPAA controls to apply. Can you share any current HIPAA attestation or the named security contact that owns HIPAA compliance?

3) Vendor security questionnaire: I'm attaching our standard vendor questionnaire (redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx). Can you return a completed copy by EOD Friday 2026-12-19? If you prefer, your security team can send a completed version or a completed equivalent.

4) Incident response & BCP/DR evidence: we need either a one-page IR escalation timeline that shows notification SLAs (e.g., initial notification within X hours, root-cause within Y days) and a sample BCP/DR runbook or table of contents. If you have a short draft timeline, please attach it.

Next steps: 
- Pioneer: confirm SOC 2 ETA, provide contact(s) for security/legal, return the questionnaire, and attach any IR/BCP artifacts.
- Redwood: Ben will prepare a tailored evidence checklist once we have the completed questionnaire; Neha will scope any technical follow-ups.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (attached)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up with your security lead next week if that helps.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@pioneerlabs.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: security@pioneerlabs.com, legal@pioneerlabs.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security documentation & incident/BCP timelines

Thanks Dylan — appreciated the clear recap. Quick answers and what we can provide this week: 

- SOC 2: We are mid-way through a Type II period (2026-07 to 2026-12) with the report scheduled to be issued by 2027-02. We can share our scope statement and the auditor engagement letter by next Wednesday (2026-12-16).

- HIPAA: Yes, Pioneer treats patient data for our Pilot program customers. We have an internal HIPAA attestation; I will ask legal to provide a short attestation and the named privacy officer.

- Questionnaire: We received the attached redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx and will have a completed version back by 2026-12-19 as requested.

- IR/BCP artifacts: attaching a one-page draft incident notification timeline (pioneer_ir_timeline_draft.pdf). It shows internal escalation (0–4 hours), customer notification target (within 24 hours for confirmed breaches), and a high-level RTO/RPO table. Security will follow-up with any redacted runbook excerpts if needed.

If you need anything else for procurement review, loop in procurement@pioneerlabs.com. Happy to set a 30-min intro between your security team and ours on 2026-12-17 or 12-18.

Attachments: pioneer_ir_timeline_draft.pdf

Best,
Jane Doe
Sr. IT Operations Manager, Pioneer Labs
jane.doe@pioneerlabs.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@pioneerlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Security documentation & incident/BCP timelines

Forwarding Pioneer’s responses and the draft IR timeline. Ben/neha — action items for Redwood: 

- Ben: after Pioneer sends the completed questionnaire, can you draft the minimal procurement checklist (SOC artifacts, HIPAA attestation, signed DPA, and IR contact list) we need before procurement signs? Aim for a one-page checklist we can send to Pioneer.

- Neha: please review the attached pioneer_ir_timeline_draft.pdf and flag any items we should clarify (notification windows, RTO/RPO targets, sample runbook excerpts). If Pioneer’s 24-hour customer notification is not sufficient for our customer use-cases, propose language for an SLA exception or accelerated notification.

- If security/legal want to take the 12-17/12-18 intro, propose 12-17 11:00 PST and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments referenced: pioneer_ir_timeline_draft.pdf

—
Dylan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@pioneerlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: Security documentation & incident/BCP timelines

Thanks for the forward — I’ll take the first pass. A few clarifying Qs and notes so Pioneer can prepare: 

1) Please confirm whether the Pioneer draft distinguishes between confirmed data exfiltration vs. service-disrupting incidents. For confirmed data exposure we typically expect initial customer notification within 24 hours of confirmation and a more detailed notification and remediation plan within 72 hours.

2) RTO/RPO: the draft’s RTO entries are broad. Can Pioneer provide RTO/RPO per critical service/component or say which component the table targets. If not available, a default target of RTO 4 hours / RPO 15 minutes for core APIs would be helpful to evaluate tolerance.

3) Artifacts we need to close the security review (please provide as separate files or redacted PDFs):
- SOC 2 scope statement and auditor engagement letter
- HIPAA attestation or BA agreements (if applicable)
- Completed vendor questionnaire (redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx)
- One or two redacted runbook excerpts showing escalation steps and owner contact details

Target timeline: we can complete an initial security review within 5 business days of receiving the completed questionnaire and SOC artifacts. If Pioneer can provide the items by 2026-12-19, we’ll aim to have a checklist and any follow-ups by 2026-12-27.

If Pioneer wants to do a quick sync, 2026-12-17 11:00 PST works for me.

—
Neha Kapoor
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 408-555-0267
